time.ordering: nondecreasing; array order breaks equal-time ties

canonicalization.note: The independent witnesses deliberately use code-point order. No RFC 8785 or JCS claim is made.

invariants: Exactly host-a and host-b exist; reachability is only host-to-authority.
The modeled authority is the only source of authoritative work, attempt, epoch, lease, and event state.
A host token is only the cached result of its last accepted acquire or renew; heal never refreshes it.
Partitioned host-bound authority commands reject before revealing work or fence state and mutate nothing.
Owner epochs strictly increase on acquire_lease and retry-attempt creation; renew_lease preserves the current epoch.
Renewal and settlement require the current attempt, host, epoch, and an unexpired half-open lease.
Cancellation is reachable-control-plane authority and requires no lease token.
Recovery is explicit and accepts only at or after lease_until.
A retry receives a distinct attempt_id and a new epoch before a later acquisition receives another new epoch.
Retry and lease arithmetic is checked before any state or event mutation.
Rejected commands append no event and leave authority, hosts, and events byte-identical.
Accepted authority mutations append dense sequence events; partition, heal, and replay_check are accepted simulation controls without authority events.
Event replay reconstructs internally generated authority state only; it is not an external event-ingestion or tamper-validation API.

Runner receipts bind each complete case output and are checked against a package manifest whose SHA-256 must be supplied by an external acceptance holder; receipt-tamper detection is separate from authority replay.
Every normalized parser or validation control binds the SHA-256 of its exact input bytes in the externally anchored package manifest.
non_claims: No network, socket, transport, process, runtime, provider, credential, authentication, or authorization implementation.
No real clock, clock synchronization, datastore, consensus, leader election, quorum, availability, or partition-tolerance proof.
No production multi-host coordinator, shared-SQLite safety, remote ownership, delivery, execution, or exactly-once side-effect claim.
No MCP tool, public ingress, activation, deployment, publication, merge, or release authority.
The package-local manifest is not an immutable provenance anchor by itself; acceptance requires its SHA-256 from a separately held receipt.
validation_precedence: Raw byte inputs are size-checked, then decoded as fatal UTF-8; invalid byte sequences reject as INVALID_UTF8.
A recursion-independent structural scan checks JSON syntax and numeric scalar tokens while parsing every object value.
Duplicate members reject when an object closes, before post-scan nesting-depth and Unicode-scalar validation.
Nesting depth and Unicode scalar validity are checked after the complete JSON value structurally scans without duplicate members and before bounded native decoding.
Scenario schema and command ordering validation run only after strict JSON parsing succeeds.
